title: Curl your grasp around rhythm like a dream breaking dawn for it slips away with light of first thought. #smallpoems #ukulele
summary: Curl your grasp around rhythm like a dream breaking dawn for it slips away with light of first thought. #smallpoems #ukulele
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Curl your
grasp around
  rhythm like
a dream breaking
dawn

  for it slips
away with
  light of first thought.

#smallpoems
#ukulele
